text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory got injured. Worried, I 
hurriedly took her to the infirmary, and—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please don't make a face like 
that! This is just a scratch!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I know! If you're feeling uneasy, I can 
try running on the dirt track for you! 
Dirt is much easier on the body, after 
all.
choice_data_list:
I'd really like you to rest, just to be 
safe...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, understood. I'll stay put until 
my injury heals up!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't want to make my Trainer, who 
I'm supposed to have my back to back with, 
feel even more anxious, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu! I'm good at holding back my pace, 
so just sit back and watch!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Oww-w-w... S-Sorry, something feels a 
bit off...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh... When I was struggling with my 
hooves, stuff like this happened all the 
time, so I thought it'd be fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Fufufu! Looking good, just like I thought!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "An injury like this isn't gonna stop me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It provided great momentum toward resuming 
training...!
